mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by ≥0.5 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate accelerating consumer demand, driving positive equity returns as earnings growth accelerates over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes, rising employment growth combined with falling unemployment rates signals tight labor markets that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP growth signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 95.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate output expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes, CPIAUCSL exceeding 305.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 305.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in industrial production growth indicates strengthening manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% quarterly.
